p.src: 1  Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.

en: Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.
u.src: 1  Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.

p.src: 2  The LORD has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.

en: The LORD has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.
u.src: 2  The LORD has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.

p.src: 3  He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

en: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
u.src: 3  He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

p.src: 4  Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!

en: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!
u.src: 4  Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!

p.src: 5  Sing praises to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.

en: Sing praises to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.
u.src: 5  Sing praises to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.

p.src: 6  With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, the LORD.

en: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, the LORD.
u.src: 6  With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, the LORD.

p.src: 7  Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.

en: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.
u.src: 7  Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.

p.src: 8  Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.

en: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.
u.src: 8  Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.

p.src: 9  Let them sing before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.

en: Let them sing before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
u.src: 9  Let them sing before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
